issue.title: Add rate limiting to the public API
issue.description:
The public API has no limit per key. On Nov 3 one customer’s import script took the read replicas down.

**What we want**

- A limit per API key, 600 requests a minute unless the plan says more
- `429` with a `Retry-After` header
- The limit shown on the usage page (ACM-371)

nodes.body: Redis is already there for the sessions. A sliding window in a Lua script would do.
Keep a fallback for when Redis is down. We cannot fail closed on reads.
